### 1 — Scene
A rice dish topped with meat, mixed vegetables, and brown sauce, accompanied by a bowl of cooked vegetables. I include both main dishes, but exclude the water and the packaged item on the separate rear plate.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 26 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.
- **Vegetable bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² ≈ **314 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Rice; meat strips, likely chicken; mixed vegetables in the sauce; brown sauce with a visible oily sheen; broccoli; carrots; and sweetcorn. Oil is included in the sauce estimate rather than counted twice.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area percentages are allocated between ingredients to avoid double-counting overlapping food. Heights represent each ingredient’s effective thickness.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Height | Gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 28% main = 149 cm² | 1.8 cm | 268 ml | 0.8 | 214 g | 130 | 278 kcal |
| Cooked meat strips | 22% main = 117 cm² | 1.4 cm | 164 ml | 0.95 | 155 g | 190 | 295 kcal |
| Mixed vegetables in main dish | 12% main = 64 cm² | 1.2 cm | 77 ml | 0.6 | 46 g | 45 | 21 kcal |
| Brown sauce, including oil | 8% main = 42 cm² | 0.35 cm | 15 ml | 1.0 | 15 g | 140 | 21 kcal |
| Broccoli | 20% bowl = 63 cm² | 2.2 cm | 138 ml | 0.6 | 83 g | 35 | 29 kcal |
| Carrots | 22% bowl = 69 cm² | 1.6 cm | 111 ml | 0.6 | 66 g | 35 | 23 kcal |
| Sweetcorn | 13% bowl = 41 cm² | 1.2 cm | 49 ml | 0.7 | 34 g | 85 | 29 kcal |

**Coverage check:** main plate **70%**; vegetable bowl **55%**, consistent with their visible uncovered rims.

### 8 — Sanity check
The main dish comes to approximately **430 g**, with **183 g** of side vegetables. A total of **613 g and about 700 kcal** is plausible for the visible portions. Meat identity and sauce oil content are the largest uncertainties.
